title.en: Cloud icons C and D are ready for your choice
title.zh: 云图标 C 和 D 等你选择

summary.en: Two new cloud-drive-at-home icons in the SF Symbols style are now on the Decisions page (/decisions/brand/), with approval request A-004: C Hearth (a house inside the cloud) and D Roofline (a cloud wearing a roof). Approve means “I choose the variant named in my note”, so write C or D in the issue note. Decision cards now have only Approve and Deny: the Choose A / Choose B buttons are gone, as you asked. Verified: type check, 11 site tests, build of 13 pages and a link check of 347 links pass. The page has not been looked at in a browser by the team; your session rendered C and D earlier.
summary.zh: 两个 SF Symbols 风格、表达“家里的云盘”的新图标已放到“决策”页（/decisions/brand/），对应审批请求 A-004：C Hearth（云里有一座房子）和 D Roofline（戴着屋顶的云）。批准表示“我选备注里写的那个方案”，请在议题备注里写 C 或 D。决策卡现在只有“批准”和“拒绝”，按你的要求去掉了“选 A / 选 B”。已验证：类型检查、11 项网站测试、13 页构建和 347 个链接检查均通过。团队尚未在浏览器中查看该页面；你的会话此前已渲染过 C 和 D。

bullets.en: **A-004:** pick icon C or D on /decisions/brand/. C is recommended for large sizes (logo, sign-in), D reads better at 16 px.
bullets.zh: **A-004：**在 /decisions/brand/ 选图标 C 或 D。大尺寸（标志、登录）推荐 C，16 px 时 D 更清楚。

bullets.en: **Decision cards:** Approve and Deny only; Choose A / Choose B removed from the site, the docs and the request format.
bullets.zh: **决策卡：**只有“批准”和“拒绝”；“选 A / 选 B”已从网站、文档和请求格式中移除。

bullets.en: **Open item:** the manager's agent file still mentions Choose X; the manager could not edit it, please change `.claude/agents/manager.md` lines 17 and 22.
bullets.zh: **待办：**经理的 agent 文件里仍提到“选 X”，经理无权编辑它，请修改 `.claude/agents/manager.md` 第 17、22 行。
